name: primitives-headless-switch
title: Headless Switch
blurb: Animated toggle switch with composable thumb and icon components.
description: Switch primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion. Features composable SwitchThumb and SwitchIcon components with spring animations.
use_when: Building premium animated switches with custom icon positioning and fine-tuned motion control.
avoid_when: When you need a simple switch without animation or custom composition.
a11y: Built on Headless UI switch primitive with full keyboard and screen reader support.
